verdicts_or_reports.expected: A single IrisSeed album containing both big.jpg and huge.jpg (2 items), as shown in Library > Folder View > Pictures > IrisSeed.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The Albums tab shows two separate cards both labeled "IrisSeed", each with "1 items": one covered by big.jpg and one covered by hughugeQ.jpg (formerly huge.jpg). The album has been split into two duplicate albums.
steps: Open Albums tab; IrisSeed shows one card with 2 items.
Open big.jpg > Details > Edit metadata & EXIF, set a Title and a Captured date, Save.
In Details tap Rename, rename big.jpg to bigQA.jpg, then return to Albums tab.
Albums tab now shows two IrisSeed cards ('big.jpg | IrisSeed | 1 items' and 'huge.jpg | IrisSeed | 1 items').
Rename bigQA.jpg back to big.jpg: the duplicate IrisSeed cards persist even after leaving and returning to the tab.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: One Beta album card showing "2 items", matching Library > Folder View > Pictures > Beta, which reports Beta with 2 items.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The Albums tab shows the Beta album twice, each card labeled "Beta" with "1 items" (covers big.jpg and hughugeQ.jpg), instead of one Beta album with 2 items.
steps: Open a photo (hughugeQ.jpg) > More selection actions > Copy to album > New album, create album named Beta.
Open another photo (big.jpg) > More selection actions > Move to album, select Beta.
Return to the Albums tab. Beta is displayed as two separate cards, each '1 items'.
Compare with Library > Folder View > Pictures: there is a single Beta folder with 2 items.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After entering a capture date (e.g. 2021-05-06 07:08) and tapping Save, reopening Edit metadata & EXIF > Origin should show that capture date in the Captured field.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The Captured field is empty again after Save and reopen - it only shows the placeholder "Captured · yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm". A Title entered in the same save (T2) persists, so the save itself works; the capture date specifically is lost.
steps: Open a photo (big.jpg) > Details > Edit metadata & EXIF > Origin.
Tap the Captured field and enter 2021-05-06 07:08 (or tap Set Current Time).
Tap Save, then tap Edit metadata & EXIF again and open Origin.
The Captured field is empty again; the typed date does not persist.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After saving Title "WAIT" and reopening the photo later, the Title should still be WAIT (viewer title bar "1 of 1 · WAIT", Details sheet showing Title WAIT, editor prefilled with WAIT).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The Title is shown right after Save, but once the photo is left and reopened the edit is gone: the title bar shows "1 of 1 · hughugeQ.jpg", the Details sheet has no Description/Title section, and the editor's Title field is empty (placeholder "Title").
steps: Open the Zulu album and open hughugeQ.jpg.
Details > Edit metadata & EXIF > Description, type Title 'WAIT', tap Save.
Details/sheet shows Title WAIT; close the viewer, go to Albums, reopen Zulu and open the photo again.
The Title is gone: title bar reads '1 of 1 · hughugeQ.jpg' and the editor's Title field is empty.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The photo details sheet should show the capture date read from the photo's EXIF metadata (for this photo the viewer header shows the EXIF capture date/time "November 14 · 11:39 AM").
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The Details sheet has no capture-date row at all. Under "Image Properties" it only lists Resolution "64 × 48 (0.0 MP)", and under "File Information" only File name, Added, Modified, Type, Size, URL and Path. The EXIF capture date is never shown in the details sheet.
steps: Open big.jpg in the viewer and tap Details.
Note the sheet shows only Resolution under Image Properties - there is no capture date.
Tap Edit metadata & EXIF > Origin, tap Set Current Time, then Save.
The viewer header updates to 'November 14 · 11:39 AM' (the EXIF capture date), but reopening Details still shows no capture date row.
